title: Employment-Oriented Vocational Training Scheme
department: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Department
eligibility: Educational qualification varies by trade: Class 8, Class 10 or Class 12.
Reservation benefits apply according to government norms.
benefits: Short-term six-month training in various trades at designated ITIs.
Training is intended to improve employment-oriented vocational skills.
documents_required: Not specified on the retrieved official scheme page.
application_process: Advertisements are issued through the Directorate via the Commissioner of Public Relations.
Applicants submit applications to the respective ITI.
After admission, trainees deposit INR 350 at the institute.
important_sections_or_clauses: The scheme is generally launched in April and October.
The scheme does not provide a scholarship.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh Mera Yuva portal
